question.prompt: The conjugate of \(1+i\) is \(1-i\). What is their product?

solutions.explanation: The product of \(z\) and its conjugate equals the square of its modulus, which is \(2\) here.
solutions.title: Conjugate product and modulus

solutions.explanation:
The factors have the same real term and opposite imaginary terms, so the difference-of-squares formula applies. Since \(i^2=-1\),
\[
(1+i)(1-i)=1-i^2=2.
\]
solutions.title: Difference of squares
